title: Futbolín
tagline: Slide and flick the rods. Score on the rival goal.
description: Table football from Spain and Latin America on a lit wooden table. Slide a rod with your thumb, flick to kick, and beat five rival levels, climb the three-round Cup, or play a friend on the same screen. A Hint names the rod to use, and Watch & Learn explains each kick.
howToPlay: Touch a rod and drag sideways to line a player up with the ball.
Flick quickly toward the rival goal to kick; a tap is a soft pass.
Where the ball meets the foot decides its angle.
Keep a player in the ball's path to defend your goal.
Win matches to 3, 5 or 7 goals, try the Cup, or pass and play with a friend.
